svg.text: Advertising, audio-visual, display

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: W

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: hile advertising, audio-visual

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: and display are separate disci-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: plines they must conform to

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: the graphic fundamentals

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: of our signatures and typeface. There are a

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: few general and specific measures which

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: facilitate this.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: General

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Whether a medium is front-lit or back-lit, high

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: quality in the reproduction of our signatures,

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: colours and typeface is required of suppliers.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Front-lit applications follow the standards set

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: out in the first pages of this manual; for back-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: lit media they are detailed in this section.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Backgrounds for the signature in audio-visual

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: and display treatments require particular

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: control in avoiding conflicting patterns, tex-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: tures or colours.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Specifications for fabricating a three-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: dimensional signature are available from the

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Advertising Department. The standards for its

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: use are described on page 35.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: In all advertising media the signature is the

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: final element of the communication.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif
